name: Honda Metropolitan
engine: 49 cc single, carb (NCH50) or fuel injected (NCW50), CVT
intro: Honda's 50 cc retro scooter. 2016-2025 bikes are in a transmission case seal recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2016-2025 Metropolitans are in recall 24V825 because the transmission case may not seal and can leak fluid.
A-002.reason: Leaking transmission fluid can reach the rear tire. The fix is free.

G: Older NCH50 scooters have a carb. 2016-on NCW50 scooters are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.

recalls.what: The transmission case may not seal to the crankcase and can leak transmission fluid.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and repairs the transmission case free.
